title: Leash and Glide
body:
### How It Works

1. Leash multiple mobs _(chickens, parrots, bees, or allays)_ and jump from a height.
2. The more mobs you have leashed, the slower you'll descend.
3. Leash up to **10** mobs to reach maximum gliding level, allowing you to gently land without taking fall damage.

Have fun with this datapack!
